notablePrerequisites: You have a basic land card in hand.
description:
If Flame Jab is in your graveyard, cast it for its retrace cost by paying {1} and discarding a basic land card, targeting Polyraptor.
Otherwise, cast it by paying {1}, targeting Polyraptor.
Resolve Flame Jab, dealing 1 damage to Polyraptor.
Polyraptor triggers, creating a token copy of itself.
The Polyraptor token enters the battlefield, triggering Mana Echoes, adding {C} for each Dinosaur you control.
If you cast Flame Jab from your graveyard, activate Groundskeeper by paying {2}, returning a basic land card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead target any other target using Flame Jab.
